# DBMind AI

> AI-powered database consulting, migration, and optimization. DBMind AI combines
> experienced database engineering with AI-assisted analysis and automation —
> recommendations are always reviewed by a database engineer before reaching a
> client; AI does not make autonomous changes to production systems.

DBMind AI serves startups, SMBs, SaaS companies, and enterprise engineering teams
across SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Azure, and AWS.

## Core services

- [Database Migration & Modernization](https://www.dbmindai.com/migration) — homogeneous (same-platform version upgrades, cloud lift-and-shift) and heterogeneous (cross-platform, e.g. Oracle to PostgreSQL) migrations, with AI-assisted migration assessment.
- [Performance Optimization](https://www.dbmindai.com/performance) — diagnosing slow queries, indexing issues, blocking, deadlocks, and resource bottlenecks.
- [Database Health Assessment](https://www.dbmindai.com/health-assessment) — a structured review of performance, reliability, security, configuration, and modernization opportunities.
- [AI-Powered Database Optimization](https://www.dbmindai.com/ai-consulting) — AI-assisted assessment, root-cause analysis, and optimization recommendations, engineer-reviewed before implementation.
